items.title: Introducing our latest image generation model in the API
items.summary: Our latest image generation model is now available in the API via ‘gpt-image-1’—enabling developers and businesses to build professional-grade, customizable visuals directly into their own tools and platforms.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI正式在API中上线了全新的图像生成模型“gpt-image-1”。该模型旨在为开发者和企业提供专业级、可定制的视觉内容生成能力，支持将其无缝集成至各类工具与平台中，进一步丰富了OpenAI的API生态系统，满足了市场对高质量AI图像生成服务的需求。
